# awscc_ecs_gateway (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS ECS Gateway



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Attributes) The configuration for the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `gateway_name` (String) The name of the gateway. Up to 255 letters (uppercase and lowercase), numbers, and hyphens are allowed.
- `infrastructure_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role that ECS uses to manage infrastructure for the gateway.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether deletion protection is enabled for the gateway.
- `propagate_tags` (String) Specifies whether to propagate the tags from the gateway to other resources.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The metadata that you apply to the gateway to help you categorize and organize them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `access_type` (String) The access type of the gateway.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the gateway.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the gateway was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the gateway.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the gateway was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Required:

- `host_shared_alb` (Attributes) The host shared ALB configuration for the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb))

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.host_shared_alb`

Optional:

- `access_logs` (Attributes) The access log configuration for the gateway ALB. Access logging is enabled by the presence of a destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--access_logs))
- `http_desync` (String) The HTTP desync mitigation mode for the ALB.
- `max_alb_count` (Number) The maximum number of ALBs to provision for the gateway.
- `network_configuration` (Attributes) The network configuration for the gateway ALB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--network_configuration))
- `port` (Number) The port on which the ALB listens.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol for the ALB listener.
- `scheme` (String) The scheme for the ALB.
- `test_traffic_rules` (Attributes) The test traffic rules for the gateway ALB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--test_traffic_rules))
- `web_acl_arn` (String) The ARN of the WAFv2 web ACL to associate with the ALB.

Read-Only:

- `current_alb_count` (Number) The current number of ALBs provisioned for the gateway.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--access_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.host_shared_alb.access_logs`

Optional:

- `destination` (Attributes) The destination for gateway ALB access logs. Exactly one destination type must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--access_logs--destination))

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--access_logs--destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.host_shared_alb.access_logs.destination`

Optional:

- `s3` (Attributes) The S3 destination for gateway ALB access logs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--access_logs--destination--s3))

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--access_logs--destination--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.host_shared_alb.access_logs.destination.s3`

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) The S3 bucket for access logs.
- `prefix` (String) The S3 prefix for access logs.




<a id="nestedatt--configuration--host_shared_alb--network_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.host_shared_alb.network_configuration`

Optional:

- `inbound_security_group` (String) The inbound security group for the ALB.
- `ip_address_type` (String) The IP address type for the ALB.
- `subnets` (List of String) The subnets for the ALB.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ecs_gateway.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the gateway

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ecs_gateway.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ecs_gateway.example "arn"
```
